name: Phoebe Teaching Joey
look: Eight panels in four rows from Friends. In each row Phoebe, with long blonde hair and a pink cardigan, talks on the left while Joey, in a dark plaid shirt, listens on the right looking confused. In the last row Joey beams and spreads his hands confidently.
use: Someone patiently repeats the right answer while the other person gets it more and more wrong. Phoebe's panels hold the correct version, Joey's hold his garbled tries, and the last panel is his confident, totally wrong final answer.
slots: the correct thing Phoebe says (left panels, first three rows)
Joey's garbled attempts (right panels, first three rows)
Joey's confident, completely wrong answer (bottom right)
describe: blonde woman teaching a guy to say something and he keeps getting it wrong
friends tv show phoebe and joey repeating words
woman patiently repeats while a man looks confused eight panels
joey trying to speak french and failing
guy in a plaid shirt says it wrong with total confidence
origin: From the Friends season 10 episode where Phoebe tries to teach Joey to say "Je m'appelle Claude" in French.
